# TV board

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

## Where you start

TV board

## Jobs you do most

1. On a desktop, choose Open on TV on Capacity, or On TV on a ward or an ED. The TV is read only, shows full names as the desks do and updates on its own. Use Change screen to pick another meeting, ward or ED, Full screen for the wall screen and Leave TV view to come back. On a TV that stays on the wall, Lock as TV keeps that browser on TV views, even after a reload, until someone presses Unlock.

## What you cannot do

- The TV view puts the bed meeting on a wall screen. It is for looking at together, not for recording.

## Colour code

- Triangle: act now.
- Filled amber circle: at risk.
- Tick: done.
- Capsule: moving.
- Ring: waiting.
- Cross: declined or closed.

## Keyboard shortcuts

- Esc: Close what is open, or step back.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
